name: Felsworn: Pit Lord's Strength rank 2 gives Annihilation 7 guaranteed-crit attacks (#1337)
contract: Pit Lord's Strength rank 2 802110 has effect 1 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER on SPELLMOD_CHARGES with base points 1 and die sides 1 (+2), mask on Annihilation 803904, description 'Your Annihilation now affects 2 additional attacks'. Annihilation's DBC ProcCharges is 5. The module counts the attacks in its own script value, which AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp set to a hard-coded 5 on apply, so the modifier never reached it. Untalented stays at 5, the rank 2 Felsworn gets 7.

steps.label: Pit Lord's Strength rank 2 adds 2 attacks
